name: enable_sort
description: Controls whether the query planner considers explicit sort steps (e.g., for merge joins or ORDER BY) during plan generation.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans with unnecessary hash joins
Poor performance on ORDER BY or merge-join-heavy workloads
Unexpected plan regressions after configuration changes
tuning_tips: Leave enabled ('on') unless diagnosing a specific planner misestimation; disabling may force less efficient alternatives and rarely improves performance. Only disable temporarily for plan comparison.
